title: Add link to a client organization
purpose: Link a client organization to a record in another system, such as an account, project or study, by typing its identifier.
summary: Link a client organization to an account, project, study or other record in another system. Every staff role can add these links. Person-level records cannot be linked here.

tasks.title: Link an account or project
steps: Choose the [[System]] and [[Record type]], then type the [[Identifier]] as that system writes it.
Select [[Add link]]. The organization's Links panel opens.

tasks.title: Add an address that opens the record
steps: Paste the https link in [[Address]] and save. It must be on the system's own host; a system without a base address takes no address.

good_to_know: Patient, research participant and donor records cannot be linked to an organization.
If the same record is already linked elsewhere, that link is reused and the label and address you type are ignored.
Links on an organization are for staff. There is no Show to client choice here.
The identifier is stored as typed and is not checked against the other system.

items.label: Record type
items.description: Order, Accession, Requisition, Sample, Custody form, Report, Invoice, Shipment, Project, Lot or batch, Study or Other. Person-level types are never offered for an organization.

items.label: Identifier
items.description: Required, up to 200 characters, as the source system writes it. Surrounding spaces are removed; control and invisible characters are refused.

items.label: Identifier scheme
items.description: Optional, up to 40 characters, for systems with several kinds of number.

items.label: Label
items.description: Optional, up to 120 characters. What staff see; empty means the identifier.

items.label: Role
items.description: Primary, Related (the default), Original, or Replacement or corrected. The same record cannot be on the organization twice in the same role.

items.label: Address
items.description: Optional https link to the record, up to 500 characters, with no user name or password. Only for a system with a base address, and on that host.

sections.title: Saving and the organization's Links panel

items.label: Add link
items.description: Adds the link, records who added it, and returns to the organization's page at its Links panel. A reused link is noted in the message.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the organization's page without saving.

items.label: Links panel
items.description: Lists Record (opens the link's page), Type, System (opens the record in a new tab when an address is set), Role and a Remove button. Removed links are kept in a collapsed list with who, when and why.
